services.description: List of daemon/service definitions. Each entry maps a daemon name to a service, socket type, and command to execute.

daemon.description: Daemon section header (e.g., 'defaults'). Usually 'defaults' for global defaults.

type.description: Socket type: 'socket' for Unix domain sockets, 'inet' for TCP ports.

cmd.description: Command to execute, including options. Use -s for socket mode, -p for port, -l for listening on all interfaces, etc.

sieve_options.description: Optional Sieve-specific configuration directives (e.g., sieve_maxscriptsize, sieve_trace_dir). Not standard in cyrus.conf, but often included as comments or via includes.

port_imap.description: TCP port for IMAP (used if 'inet' sockets are enabled instead of sockets).

port_pop3.description: TCP port for POP3 (used if 'inet' sockets are enabled instead of sockets).

port_sieve.description: TCP port for ManageSieve (used if 'inet' sockets are enabled).

socket_path.description: Base directory for Unix domain sockets (e.g., /var/lib/imap/socket/lmtp).

enable_inet.description: If true, configure inet (TCP) sockets for services instead of Unix domain sockets.
